questions.question: Which part of a plant usually absorbs water from the soil?
Which organ pumps blood around the body?
Which is a renewable source of energy?
Which material is transparent?
Which change can usually be reversed?
Which force slows a toy car on a rough floor?
Which animal is adapted to a hot desert?
Which body part protects the brain?
Which gas do humans need for breathing?
Which state of matter keeps its own shape?
A plant is kept without water for many days. What is most likely to happen?
A metal spoon becomes hot in soup faster than a wooden spoon. Why?
Why do we see lightning before hearing thunder?
options: Thunder happens later in the sky

questions.question: Which is the safest way to test a science idea?
options: Change one main condition and compare results

questions.question: A plant's roots are kept sitting in waterlogged soil for many days. What is most likely to happen?
options: The roots may rot due to lack of air

questions.question: Why are the handles of cooking pots often made of plastic or wood instead of metal?
options: Plastic and wood do not conduct heat well, so handles stay cool
Metal cannot be shaped into handles

questions.question: During a thunderstorm, if you count the seconds between seeing lightning and hearing thunder, what can you estimate?
options: Roughly how far away the storm is

questions.question: A student wants to find out if warm water dissolves sugar faster than cold water. What is the safest and fairest way to test this?
options: Use different amounts of sugar for each test
Use the same amount of sugar and water, only changing the temperature
Use hot water for one and juice for the other

questions.question: Two identical plants are grown, one watered daily and one never watered. After a week, what will you likely observe?
options: The unwatered plant wilts and droops

questions.question: A metal spoon left in a cup of hot tea becomes warm even at the end you're holding. What does this show?
options: Metal is a poor conductor of heat
Metal is a good conductor of heat
Metal does not get hot at all

questions.question: What actually causes the sound of thunder during a storm?
options: The rapid heating and expansion of air near a lightning bolt
The clouds crashing into each other

questions.question: Which of these is the safest way to observe how a magnet affects different objects?
options: Test one object at a time and record what happens
Throw all objects at the magnet together
Use a magnet near electrical sockets

questions.question: A seed is planted but kept away from sunlight completely. What will most likely happen to the seedling?
options: It grows pale, thin, and weak (etiolated)
It turns into a flower immediately

questions.question: Which material would be the best choice for making a cooking pan's base, and why?
options: Metal, because it conducts heat well for cooking

questions.question: Why is it unsafe to stand under a tall tree during a thunderstorm?
options: Tall objects can attract lightning strikes

questions.question: To find out which material is the best insulator, what is the safest and fairest testing method?
options: Test different materials one at a time under the same conditions
Test only one material and guess about the rest
Use fire to test all materials directly
Ask a friend to guess for you

questions.question: A plant is placed near a window where it leans towards the light over time. What is this response called?
On a cold morning, a metal railing feels much colder to touch than a wooden railing at the same temperature. Why?
options: Metal is actually colder than wood
Metal conducts heat away from your hand faster
Wood is always warmer than metal

questions.question: Sound and light are both produced during lightning, but which one reaches our ears/eyes first and why?
options: Sound first, because it is louder
Light first, because it travels faster than sound
Both reach at exactly the same time

questions.question: What is the safest first step before starting any simple classroom science experiment?
options: Read and understand the instructions, and check for safety precautions
Skip asking the teacher any questions

questions.question: A student notices that plants near a busy road are covered in dust and grow slower. What is the most likely reason?
options: Dust blocks sunlight needed for photosynthesis

questions.question: Two ice cubes are left out, one in sunlight and one in shade. Which will most likely melt faster, and why?
options: The one in shade, because shade is warmer
The one in sunlight, because sunlight provides more heat
Both melt at exactly the same speed

questions.question: A student wants to know if plants grow better with tap water or rainwater. What should stay the same in both plant pots for a fair test?
options: Everything except the type of water
The size of the pots only
Nothing needs to stay the same

questions.question: Why might a scientist repeat an experiment several times before drawing a conclusion?
options: To make sure the results are reliable and not just a one-time chance
Because the first result is always wrong
It is not necessary to repeat experiments

questions.question: A balloon rubbed on hair can pick up small bits of paper. What does this demonstrate?
